records.statement: The 0.13.0 large single-LOD baseline exposed resource-loading throughput as the first material scaling pressure visible in the tested fixture.
The baseline did not isolate the internal cause of the observed loading latency.
Resource-loading analysis and a resulting loading-architecture decision should precede LOD architecture work.
Planning records should preserve distinctions among intent, evidence, constraints, decisions, desired outcomes, and unresolved questions without prescribing implementation details prematurely.
